# FLX-3610: a consumer query's parameters are malformed

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

parameters maps at most 256 placeholder names, each of the form [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}, to a value written as a string, a whole number or a boolean. A float is refused, as every number in a bundle is exact.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3610
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
